name: pi-reviewer

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/cli.ts ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun -e 'import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync, cpSync } from "node:fs"; import { basename, join } from "node:path"; const d = `dist`; const copy = (s, t) => copyFileSync(s, join(d, t)); copy(`src/ocr/template/task-template.json`, `task-template.json`); copy(`src/ocr/template/scan-template.json`, `scan-template.json`); copy(`src/ocr/rules/supported_file_types.json`, `supported_file_types.json`); copy(`src/ocr/rules/default_exclude_patterns.json`, `default_exclude_patterns.json`); copy(`src/ocr/rules/system_rules.json`, `system_rules.json`); cpSync(`src/ocr/template/prompts`, join(d, `prompts`), { recursive: true, filter: (src) => basename(src) !== `PROVENANCE.json` }); cpSync(`src/ocr/rules/rule_docs`, join(d, `rule_docs`), { recursive: true, filter: (src) => basename(src) !== `PROVENANCE.json` }); console.log(`copied runtime data files`)'
scripts.clean: bun -e 'import { rm } from "node:fs/promises"; await rm("dist", { recursive: true, force: true })'

description: Independent code review engine for the Pi SDK, derived from Open Code Review v1.9.9
author: bermudi
